_comment: Fixed topic set for A/B experiments. Hold these constant so score deltas are attributable to settings, not topic luck. Mix of content-rich and obscure on purpose.

topics.title: The Race to Solve Longitude
topics.angle: The 18th-century contest between clockmakers and astronomers to fix a ship's position at sea — a content-rich topic with famous books, docs, and lectures.

topics.title: Synesthesia and the Crossed Senses
topics.angle: People who taste words or see colored numbers — a well-covered science topic with TED talks, essays, and podcasts.

topics.title: The Whistled Languages of Mountain Villages
topics.angle: Full languages conveyed entirely by whistling across valleys — a genuinely obscure topic where good content is scarcer.

topics.title: The Bog Bodies of Iron Age Europe
topics.angle: Preserved millennia-old corpses pulled from peat bogs, and what they reveal about ritual and violence — niche but with some strong documentaries.
